facts.text: Student employees working at The Christ Hospital are automatically enrolled into the Career Pathways Program to receive tuition incentives, paid shadow opportunities, and a loyalty sign-on bonus for future RN positions.

sources.title: Bachelor of Science in Nursing - The Christ College of Nursing
sources.quote: Student employees are automatically placed into the Career Pathways Program to receive tuition incentives, paid shadow opportunities, and a loyalty sign on bonus for future RN positions at The Christ Hospital.

facts.text: The Bachelor of Science in Nursing program provides an option for first-time degree seekers to complete their BSN degree in three years.

sources.title: Bachelor of Science in Nursing - The Christ College of Nursing
